v2 REVISES v1's FALSIFIER WORDING AND ITS ROSTER NUMBERS. The MECHANISM of v1 -- that the ADDR16_LO home-copy class splits by the DESTINATION register of the paid copy into shape B (callee-saved, source-unreachable) and shape V (volatile, decl-order lever live), and that shape V splits again by polarity -- is unchanged and still correct. Two things in v1 are not.

(1) THE FALSIFIER WAS WRITTEN ON THE WRONG OBSERVABLE, AND ITS DISCHARGE WAS THEREFORE AMBIGUOUS. v1's falsifier (2) reads VERBATIM: 'THE POLARITY CUT, which is the load-bearing and least-tested claim here: it rests on TWO probes, one each way, so it is the weakest link by construction. ProcessCritterList is the one untried row carrying the responsive polarity -- if a declaration-order swap there is NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, the polarity stops predicting and the reachable remainder is ZERO, not one.' attempt.CR_processcritterlist-the-declaration-order-lever-is-inert-here-so-the-addr16lo-reachable-remainder-is-zero.20260904.v1 (06:00Z, 1h48m after v1) measured three declaration orders on that row, and TWO of the three were NOT neutral-identical: both printed `REGRESSED vs best 29: real 29 -> 37 (insns T49/O50, multiset 1t)`. Under v1's literal wording a REGRESSING swap is a third state the falsifier does not admit -- neither the NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL that discharges it nor a removal of the copy that would confirm the polarity -- so the law could be read as still standing. What CR actually established is the decisive thing, and it is stated on the class's own observables rather than on an object digest: in ALL THREE orders the instruction count stayed T49/O50 and the surplus `addi r5,r4,0` survived unchanged. v1's decisive observables are THE COPY and THE COUNT; its falsifier was written on the DIGEST. RESTATED, and this is v2's operative falsifier: the polarity cut dies if no declaration order on a responsive-polarity row removes the surplus `addi r5,r4,0` or moves the count off T49/O50. So restated, CR discharges it, and THE REACHABLE REMAINDER IS ZERO, not one. v1's closing sentence 'the reachable remainder is ONE function -- ProcessCritterList' is superseded: that row is measured inert and carries a typed denial of the axis.

(2) THE ROSTER NUMBERS WERE STALE WHEN WRITTEN AND HAVE MOVED TWICE SINCE. v1 states VERBATIM: 'MEASURED at run 53 with tools/gdl/composed_census/al_dest_split.py: of the 45-function P roster, 40 are B, 5 are V (_AdsThread, ProcessCritterList, check_prefs_loaded, setup_vmu_entries and move_logic22).' Three readings of that same tool now exist, from three commits: 45 / B40 / V5 as published; `V 4 / B 39 / TOTAL 43 of 43` at 84f85a96a (attempt.CU_addr16-live-zero-law-reconciliation-four-contradictions-and-every-roster-number-in-the-family-is-stale-at-head.20260904.v1); and, MEASURED FOR THIS RECORD at e5eb50945, `python tools/gdl/composed_census/al_dest_split.py` exit 0 printing `=== TOTALS / V 4 / B 37 / TOTAL 41 of 41 P-roster rows resolved`. move_logic22 left the V roster when its own decl-order fix landed (commit cdf25509e, cited by v1 itself); the B roster has since shed three more. THE RULE THIS FORCES, and it is why the numbers are in the law rather than only in an attempt: NO ROSTER IN THIS FAMILY MAY BE QUOTED FROM A RECORD. Run the tool. Every published count in the family has been falsified by its own reproduction command within days of publication, including this law's, including its predecessor's, and including the count in the record that first reported the staleness.

WHAT IS UNCHANGED AND WAS RE-RUN AS A NEGATIVE CONTROL AT e5eb50945: the V/B cut itself still resolves every row (41 of 41), the four V members are still `_AdsThread`, `ProcessCritterList`, `check_prefs_loaded`, `setup_vmu_entries`, and their polarity labels are unchanged -- al_dest_split prints ProcessCritterList `[ours-in-place/target-fresh]` and the other three `[mirror-or-other]`. The B half's source-unreachability is untouched by anything here: `python tools/gdl/addrlo_home_general_census.py` still prints `POPULATION S (INVERSE) (n=0)`.
